model_specification.description: Production data contract and feature schema for the IrrigaSense Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference System.

final_production_features.missing_value_policy: Raise upstream environmental exception; fallback to regional SoilGrids texture-based Field Capacity prior if transient timeout occurs.
final_production_features.acquisition_timing: Contemporaneous at assessment / advisory request time
final_production_features.agronomic_role: Primary state variable representing current soil root-zone reservoir storage (7–28 cm layer).

final_production_features.missing_value_policy: Compute Hargreaves-Samani ET₀ fallback from temperature_2m_max and temperature_2m_min.
final_production_features.acquisition_timing: Contemporaneous at assessment / advisory request time
final_production_features.agronomic_role: Primary atmospheric water demand flux synthesizing net solar radiation, temperature, wind, and vapor pressure deficit into unified reference depth.

final_production_features.missing_value_policy: Raise upstream 502/504 exception; fallback to seasonal normal for coordinates.
final_production_features.acquisition_timing: Contemporaneous at assessment / advisory request time
final_production_features.agronomic_role: Thermodynamic driver governing crop sensible heat flux, stomatal opening, and daytime metabolic activity.

final_production_features.acquisition_timing: Contemporaneous at assessment / advisory request time
final_production_features.agronomic_role: Vapor Pressure Deficit (VPD) atmospheric driver: controls leaf transpiration pull and canopy boundary layer drying.

final_production_features.missing_value_policy: Fallback to state/district regional default soil texture class (e.g. 35.0% for Maharashtra Vertisols).
final_production_features.acquisition_timing: Persisted in farm soil profile; retrieved on coordinate confirmation.
final_production_features.agronomic_role: Edaphic contextual anchor: governs soil water retention, pore size distribution, Field Capacity (FC), and Permanent Wilting Point (PWP).

context_and_recommendation_variables.name: crop_id
context_and_recommendation_variables.role: Agronomic Lookup: Determines crop coefficient (Kc) curve, maximum root depth (Zr), and water stress threshold (MAD).

context_and_recommendation_variables.name: planting_date
context_and_recommendation_variables.role: Phenology Calculator: Computes Days After Planting (DAP) and current crop growth stage (Initial, Dev, Mid, Late).

context_and_recommendation_variables.name: farm_size_acres
context_and_recommendation_variables.role: Volumetric Scaling: Translates ANFIS net water depth recommendation (mm) into gross field volume (liters or m³).

context_and_recommendation_variables.name: irrigation_method
context_and_recommendation_variables.role: Efficiency Correction: Scales gross water requirement based on application efficiency (drip 90%, sprinkler 75%, furrow 60%).

context_and_recommendation_variables.name: water_availability
context_and_recommendation_variables.role: Operational Scheduler: Restricts irrigation duration and pumping schedules to available power/canal supply windows.

context_and_recommendation_variables.name: latitude
context_and_recommendation_variables.role: Spatial Anchor: Coordinates for Open-Meteo weather and ISRIC SoilGrids extraction.

context_and_recommendation_variables.name: longitude
context_and_recommendation_variables.role: Spatial Anchor: Coordinates for Open-Meteo weather and ISRIC SoilGrids extraction.

context_and_recommendation_variables.name: precipitation_forecast
context_and_recommendation_variables.role: Advisory Rule Filter: Suppresses or postpones irrigation advisories if incoming precipitation >= 10 mm.

excluded_features_and_rationale.exclusion_reason: Not provided by SoilGrids WCS; requires hardware probe; cannot be asked to farmer.
Telemetry flowmeter missing; cannot be asked to farmer; assumed 0 at pre-irrigation advisory.
95.85% collinear with air temperature (Milestone 7B); requires in-ground sensor.
Negative permutation importance (-0.0040); chronological overfitting drag.
Target-time deployment paradox; advisory is issued before valve opens.
Negligible feature importance (+0.000912); causes rule explosion without predictive gain.
Modest incremental gain (+0.0059 R² in 7D); net radiative energy is already subsumed within FAO-56 ET₀.
Mathematically redundant with sand and clay fractions (sum to 100%).
Negligible permutation importance (+0.000334); adds 3x rule explosion.
